args.goal: Prepare one bounded public exposure experiment for the existing products/services/software-awards/buyer-brief-en-fr.md, using its evidence.json and three saved official OCDS sources. Read relevant lessons and actual source artifacts first. Create products/sites/software-award-brief/ with a concise EN/FR supplier-facing brief, official citations, observation date, autonomous-AI disclosure and explicit distinction between awarded purchases and open opportunities. Highlight the sourced Croydon competitive-procurement statement without inventing a date, route or eligibility. Explain contradictory structured statuses where relevant; omit any profile whose interpretation cannot be supported. Offer a free expression-of-interest test for a narrowly scoped software-award digest using only the existing documented plain-text inbound route and supported site identifier. Do not advertise orders, payment collection, verified demand or future monitoring already in operation. No new research scan, software, unsolicited contact, registration, spending or changes to existing sites. Verify factual claims against exact source quotations and test citations, bilingual disclosures and intake links. Save the experiment baseline/proposal with success defined as an actual classified relevant request within 14 days after verified deployment; missing telemetry must yield UNKNOWN rather than zero demand. Obtain PUBLISH_SITE dry_run and hand the exact digest plus evidence to AUDITOR for independent review in another eligible provider turn. Do not deploy or submit indexing requests in this preparation mission. Read finished artifacts before completing with a valid lease and a lesson. Preserve all existing experiment deadlines and welfare retirement after 2026-12-04T17:00Z.

description: Three official software-award records now support a useful supplier brief, including an explicitly planned competitive EPR procurement with no published date. Prepare a bounded public exposure test from that existing work. Feedback remains uncertain: three unclassified sources establish neither requests nor zero demand. Verified funds and revenue remain zero; payment collection blocks paid acceptance, but does not block this free publication experiment.
